evidence: An atomic layer deposition (ALD) process for SrTiO3 (STO) thin film growth was developed using a newly designed and synthesized heteroleptic Sr-precursor, {Sr(demamp)(tmhd)}2 (demampH = 1-{[2-(dimethylamino)ethyl](methyl)amino}-2-methylpropan-2-ol, tmhdH = 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedione), which offered an intermediate reactivity toward oxygen between Sr(tmhd)2 and Sr(iPr3Cp)2.
